llamacpp local provider routes requests via llamacpp/ model prefix with no auth

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY") ??
  throw new InvalidOperationException("API_KEY must be set");
using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null);
var result = await client.ChatAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "llamacpp/my-model" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Choices);
Console.WriteLine(result.Choices[0].Message.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Choices[0].FinishReason);
Console.WriteLine(result.Model);
```
